definitions: To be able to deal with even a very simple problem or situation; often used in negative constructions to describe someone as incompetent.
examples: He's so useless, he couldn't find his way out of a wet paper bag.
I doubt she could find her way out of a wet paper bag if left to her own devices.
lemma: find one's way out of a wet paper bag
synonyms: couldn't organize a piss-up in a brewery
not the sharpest tool in the shed
not playing with a full deck
source: find one's way out of a wet paper bag
